lri.config.title: Local Recipe Inject
lri.config.forceLocalRecipes.tip: Inject locally-known recipes regardless of what the server sends. OFF = vanilla behavior.
lri.config.includeModded.tip: Also inject recipes added by installed mods (not just vanilla).
lri.config.markConflicts.tip: When a local recipe shares an id with a server one but differs, flag/skip it to avoid misleading info.
lri.config.skipSpecial.tip: Skip dynamic/special recipes (e.g. map cloning) that have no fixed display.
lri.config.logInjection.tip: Print how many recipes were injected on each world join.
